label: About
title: About White Weight on the Playing Field
short_blurb: A daily generated front page where the image is the interface.
body: Daily Frontpage is a daily generated interactive front page. Each edition starts from recent saved signals and source research, becomes a new image-led scene, and stays explorable in the archive. The image is the interface: visible marks, objects, and surfaces in the scene open the real sources that shaped the day.

This iteration began with 48 recent saved-signal files and 12 captured links, then narrowed the page to 7 source windows around @manuel_marsol: Muerte de un futbolista (Gunnar Pohjola, 1967) and @ancilladominii: Winter gas-station photography, plus 5 more. A source image from pbs.twimg.com helped set the palette, contrast, edge behavior, and gesture. The scene became White Weight on the Playing Field: Flattened green pitch: a vast ragged white-gray plume overlaps a fine goal; a blue-shadowed chalk bank with yellow lip counters it. Broad green separates these from a compact group of blunt red/white, ochre/black and cream players, gray ball, raster scuff and folded silver chip. After the image was made, a plate-reading pass mapped 6 visible regions and the mask audit tightened them against Ragged white-gray plume overlapping the goal, Curved chalk bank with blue underside and ochre-yellow rim, and Broken multicolored turf abrasion below and right of the players.
